result.reasoning: This commit ("improve management of a dokan filesystem") introduced the core buggy logic that the fix corrects: (1) it introduced the synchronous, blocking call `NativeMethods.DokanMain(...)` in `start()` without any timeout/async wrapping, which is what necessitated the fix's addition of `CompletableFuture`/timeout logic to allow `shutdown()` to actually be reachable and successfully unmount; and (2) it introduced the flawed `isMounted.set(NativeMethods.DokanRemoveMountPoint(...))` followed by `if (isMounted.get())` logic in `shutdown()`, which wrongly sets/interprets the isMounted flag (setting it to the return value of the unmount call rather than clearing it on success), exactly the "Wrongly set isMounted variable during shutdown" bug the fix addresses. The subsequent commit 08ec099de587 only added a TODO comment with no semantic change.
